title: Pause: nothing the system finds publishes by itself until the data-capture review's fixes are live
why: Jason's explicit live-site call, through the CEO (2026-11-28 01:25 UTC): "Pause it. Yes". Live harm: bad health data (the listing audit, research/listing-audit-2026-11-27.md: about 240 people shown as places, hospitals filed as clinics), and the review that fixes it (research/data-capture-review-2026-12-02.md). The session manager: live harm, no daily slot, next after #326.

changes.what: Auto-publish is paused at its one gate (AutoImport::enabled, which every automatic publish asks first: arrival at staging, the listings pipeline (listings_tick), Find it (guide_finds_tick), refresh's other locations, the place store). Finds still arrive, are matched, and fill a listed business's gaps. They wait in Review, where a person can still approve one. The reason shows where Auto-import is: "Paused on Jason's call 2026-11-28: 'Pause it. Yes' (the data-capture review)".
The dashboard's Auto-import line reads the same answer (it read .env alone before), with the pause's reason.

The ingest endpoint (api/ingest.php: a worker's direct write with no gate of its own; nothing of ours calls it today) doesn't refuse while paused (the CEO: no caller fails, retries or loses a find). It stages each record for Review, unpublished and held, and answers success with "held for review" and how many it held.

While paused, the system writes no About text or hours into a published listing on its own, on every path that would: W2's refresh (its website, or Common Crawl's copy), the automatic gap-filling of a matched find (obvious merges, the helper's sweep), the evidence (Identity::applyEvidence, where a merge's adopt, the identity worker and the place store land), and a twin merge's copy (ListingIdentity::merge, unless a person merges). Each holds them as one suggestion for Review (a second find added to it), the About kept in full (Suggestions' machine-only field; the visitors' form is unchanged). Phone, offerings and the map point still fill. A person's own save (the owner's portal, the staff editor) writes at once, as today.
The FAQ says new businesses aren't added by the crawler for now, and why.

tier4: IT Manager (11): a change to the listings pipeline's gate
notes: Why the gate and not the W1 task switches (the first plan): switching the tasks off would also stop reading (CEO: "reading, matching, the indexer … keep running"). And it would leave five other paths publishing: refresh's other locations (W2), the place store (W3), Find it, the listings pipeline, and api/ingest.php. No per-job pause flag exists in Scheduler (Automation::job only follows workflows). The gate stops all of them in one place, and no switch or record is changed. Way back: this release's Roll back, or a one-line release emptying AutoImport::PAUSED once the review's fixes are live. About text and hours: held for Review while paused (AutoImport::holdForReview: one suggestion per listing and source, kind fix, a second find appended, its note naming the pause). Tests: tools/pause-tests/pause.php and tools/pause-tests/identity.php (the real Identity::applyEvidence on MariaDB). Admin's test: Admin → Auto-imports and the dashboard say Off with the reason; Review keeps filling; a person's Approve still publishes. Nothing is deleted or hidden. Check after live: no new crawler-made listings in 1A (the public search's counts at 01:30 UTC against an hour after live).
